snippet.title: Holiday Motel Simulator – Gameplay Trailer | COMING TO STEAM THIS SUMMER
snippet.description:
🏝️  Wishlist on Steam now!
 
🔗  https://store.steampowered.com/app/2812420/Holiday_Motel_Simulator/

From dust to paradise! Make your dream come true and create the perfect getaway that will amaze your guests. Holiday Motel Simulator lets you step into the role of the owner of an abandoned property. Renovate, decorate, manage the shop, and serve colorful cocktails and delicious snacks at the beach bar.

Key Features:
☀️ Do it yourself – start your adventure from scratch by planning and carrying out a full renovation of the property.
🌴 Boho style – furnish each room, so that guests with different tastes feel at home.
⛱️ Penny by penny – run the motel’s shop, so your guests have everything they need right at their fingertips.
🍹 More than just motel visitors – run your own beach bar where you’ll serve refreshing cocktails and tasty snacks.

Manage every aspect of the motel’s business and make sure it becomes a top choice for travelers!
Holiday Motel Simulator is coming to Early Access on Steam this summer!
